## Step 1: Create an integration

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to a project's home page. -->
2. Select **+ Create Integration**. The **Create New Integration** form opens.
3. Select **Create**.

## Step 2: Change the log level

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to Loggers in the integration sidebar. -->
2. <!-- manual: Find the environment section for the environment you want to update. -->
3. <!-- manual: In the Log Level column, click the dropdown next to the component and select a new level. -->

## Step 3: Start or stop a listener

1. <!-- manual: Open the integration and go to Overview. -->
2. In the environment card, select **Entry Points**.
3. <!-- manual: Click the listener you want to control. The listener detail panel opens on the right. -->
4. <!-- manual: Use the toggle (State) in the panel to start or stop the listener. -->
5. A confirmation dialog appears. Click **Enable** or **Disable** to confirm.
